en.bdb: Millions of bathings at pilgrimage centres on auspicious occasions;
Serving at the places of gods and goddesses;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਲਖ ਸਾਧਿ ਸਧਾਵਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: jap tap sa(n)jam lakh saadh sadhaavanaa|

en.bdb: Observance of austerities and millions of praxis by being meditative and full of continence
Offerings through yajn and horns etc;

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਲਖ ਦਾਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: varat nem lakh dhaan karam kamaavanaa|

en.bdb: Fasts, dos and donots and millions of charities (for the sake of show business)
Have absolutely no meaning in that true court of the Lord.
